user.title: Set up Hausarbeit-Tracker
user.description: Creates the household. Manage people, tasks and targets afterwards via the options.

data_description.title: Shown as the device name, e.g. "Home".

data_description.stats_days: Time window of the person sensors and the stats card (1–3650 days).

data_description.name: Shown on the cards and used for the sensor name.
data_description.color: Optional CSS color for the claim card, e.g. #3f51b5 or teal. Leave empty for the theme color.

log_execution.name: Log a completed chore
log_execution.description: Records that a person completed a task. Returns the new execution_id.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: Person ID (per_…). Shown as the person_id attribute of the person sensor.

task_id.name: Task
task_id.description: Task ID (tsk_…). Shown as the task_id attribute of the "last done" sensor.

ts.name: Time
ts.description: Optional. Defaults to now; use it to log something afterwards. Without a time zone, Home Assistant's local time is used.

delete_execution.name: Delete a log entry
delete_execution.description: Deletes a logged execution by its ID (admin only).

correct_execution.description: Changes person, task, time or note of a logged execution (admin only).
